Hook: हरेक software को monthly subscription तिर्नुपर्छ भन्ने छैन। आज 12 practical alternatives test गर्छौं।
Intro: नमस्कार, म Laxman Nepal। Global search intent target गरिएको छ, explanation नेपालीमा।
Body: expensive tool → free replacement → real test → limitation → verdict.
Outro: कुन subscription cancel गर्न सकिन्छ?

shorts.title: Stop Paying for This Software
shorts.script: यो कामका लागि expensive subscription चाहिँदैन। Free alternative ले basic workflow cover गर्छ।

shorts.title: One Free Tool That Saves Money
shorts.script: Monthly subscription अघि यो free alternative check गर्नुहोस्। मैले practical task मा test गरेको result यस्तो छ।

editing.broll: Pricing pages, tool UI, task demonstrations
editing.retention: Keep a running estimated savings counter.

shorts.title: One Long Video = 5 Shorts
shorts.script: Long video लाई पाँच भागमा काट्नु मात्र होइन। प्रत्येक Short को आफ्नै hook र payoff हुनुपर्छ। पाँच formats यस्तो हुन्छ।

shorts.title: Don't Make Boring Shorts From Long Videos
shorts.script: Long video को random 30 seconds काटेर Short नबनाउनुहोस्। एउटा idea, एउटा payoff, एउटा hook—यही rule प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।

editing.broll: Timeline with five marked segments, vertical previews
editing.retention: Teach the framework with a real example from start to finish.

thumbnail.concept: AI answer on one side, verified source on the other.

long_video.title: How I Fact-Check AI Answers Before Publishing
long_video.script:
Hook: AI ले confident answer दियो भन्दैमा त्यो सही हुन्छ भन्ने छैन। आज publish गर्नु अघि मैले गर्ने fact-check workflow देखाउँछु।
Intro: नमस्कार, म Laxman Nepal। Global research problem लाई नेपालीमा explain गर्दैछु।
Body: claim extraction → primary source → second source → date check → contradiction → final wording.
Outro: तपाईं content बनाउँदा कुन source लाई first priority दिनुहुन्छ?

shorts.title: AI Answer Wrong हुन सक्छ
shorts.script: AI को confident answer देखेर तुरुन्त publish नगर्नुहोस्। पहिले source, date र original claim check गर्नुहोस्।

shorts.title: My 3-Step AI Fact Check
shorts.script: AI answer आएको छ? तीन step: original source खोज्नुहोस्, date verify गर्नुहोस्, अर्को reliable source सँग compare गर्नुहोस्।

editing.hook: Show an AI answer that needs verification
editing.broll: Source pages, highlighted claims, comparison table
editing.retention: Reveal the verification result at each step rather than all at once.
